items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: And the alto players in the band was Marshall Royal and Ray Perry, and the baritone player was the co-writer of 'Open the Door, Richard.

ctx.x: And the alto players in the band was Marshall Royal and Ray Perry, and the baritone player was the co-writer of 'Open the Door, Richard.' I'll think of his name a little later.
But the trumpets in that band was Ernie Royal, Joe Newman, and Karl George.
